verses.original: ה֣וֹי בָּנִ֤ים סֽוֹרְרִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת עֵצָה֙ וְלֹ֣א מִנִּ֔י וְלִנְסֹ֥ךְ מַסֵּכָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א רוּחִ֑י לְמַ֛עַן סְפ֥וֹת חַטָּ֖את עַל־ חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w bā·nîm sō·wr·rîm nə·’um- Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘ê·ṣāh wə·lō min·nî wə·lin·sōḵ mas·sê·ḵāh wə·lō rū·ḥî lə·ma·‘an sə·p̄ō·wṯ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Woe to the rebellious children declares the LORD to those who carry out a plan that is not Mine who form an alliance but against My will . . . heaping up sin upon sin
verses.literalPt: Ai dos filhos rebeldes, diz Jeová, que tomam conselho, porém não de mim; que urdem uma teia, porém não pelo meu espírito, para acrescentarem pecado sobre pecado!

verses.original: הַהֹלְכִים֙ לָרֶ֣דֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם וּפִ֖י לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לוּ לָעוֹז֙ בְּמָע֣וֹז פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלַחְס֖וֹת בְּצֵ֥ל מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hō·lə·ḵîm lā·re·ḏeṯ miṣ·ra·yim ū·p̄î lō šā·’ā·lū lā·‘ō·wz bə·mā·‘ō·wz par·‘ōh wə·laḥ·sō·wṯ bə·ṣêl miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: They set out to go down to Egypt without asking My advice to seek shelter under Pharaoh’s protection and take refuge in Egypt’s shade
verses.literalPt: Que se põem a caminho para descer ao Egito e não têm consultado a minha boca, para fugirem ao asilo de Faraó e para confiarem na sombra do Egito!

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם מָע֥וֹז פַּרְעֹ֖ה לְבֹ֑שֶׁת וְהֶחָס֥וּת בְּצֵל־ מִצְרַ֖יִם לִכְלִמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lā·ḵem mā·‘ō·wz par·‘ōh lə·ḇō·šeṯ wə·he·ḥā·sūṯ bə·ṣêl- miṣ·ra·yim liḵ·lim·māh
verses.literal: But Pharaoh’s protection will become your shame and the refuge of Egypt’s shade your disgrace
verses.literalPt: Portanto, o asilo de Faraó se vos tornará em vergonha, e a confiança na sombra do Egito, em confusão.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָי֥וּ בְצֹ֖עַן שָׂרָ֑יו וּמַלְאָכָ֖יו חָנֵ֥ס יַגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·yū ḇə·ṣō·‘an śā·rāw ū·mal·’ā·ḵāw ḥā·nês yag·gî·‘ū
verses.literal: For though their princes are at Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes
verses.literalPt: Pois os seus príncipes já estão em Zoã, e os seus embaixadores já chegaram a Hanes.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל הִבְאִישׁ עַל־ עַ֖ם לֹא־ יוֹעִ֣ילוּ לָ֑מוֹ לֹ֤א לְעֵ֙זֶר֙ וְלֹ֣א לְהוֹעִ֔יל כִּ֥י לְבֹ֖שֶׁת וְגַם־ לְחֶרְפָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōl hiḇ·ʾīš ‘al- ‘am lō- yō·w·‘î·lū lā·mōw lō lə·‘ê·zer wə·lō lə·hō·w·‘îl kî lə·ḇō·šeṯ wə·ḡam- lə·ḥer·pāh
verses.literal: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them They bring neither help nor benefit but only shame and disgrace
verses.literalPt: Todos serão envergonhados de um povo que não lhes pode aproveitar, que não serve de auxílio nem de proveito, porém de vergonha como também de opróbrio.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בַּהֲמ֣וֹת נֶ֑גֶב בְּאֶרֶץ֩ צָרָ֨ה וְצוּקָ֜ה לָבִ֧יא וָלַ֣יִשׁ מֵהֶ֗ם אֶפְעֶה֙ וְשָׂרָ֣ף מְעוֹפֵ֔ף יִשְׂאוּ֩ עַל־ כֶּ֨תֶף עֲיָרִ֜ים חֵֽילֵהֶ֗ם וְעַל־ דַּבֶּ֤שֶׁת גְּמַלִּים֙ אֽוֹצְרֹתָ֔ם עַל־ עַ֖ם לֹ֥א יוֹעִֽילוּ׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā ba·hă·mō·wṯ ne·ḡeḇ bə·’e·reṣ ṣā·rāh wə·ṣū·qāh lā·ḇî wā·la·yiš mê·hem ’ep̄·‘eh wə·śā·rāp̄ mə·‘ō·w·p̄êp̄ yiś·’ū ‘al- ke·ṯep̄ ‘ă·yā·rîm ḥê·lê·hem wə·‘al- dab·be·šeṯ gə·mal·lîm ’ō·wṣ·rō·ṯām ‘al- ‘am lō yō·w·‘î·lū
verses.literal: This is the burden against the beasts of the Negev Through a land of hardship and distress of lioness and lion . . . of viper and flying serpent they carry their wealth on the backs of donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels to a people of no profit to them
verses.literalPt: A sentença acerca das bestas do Sul. Através da terra da tribulação e angústia, de onde vêm a leoa e o leão, a víbora e a serpente ardente e voadora, levam sobre os ombros de jumentinhos as suas riquezas e, sobre as corcovas dos camelos, os seus tesouros, para um povo que não lhes aproveitará.

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֕יִם הֶ֥בֶל וָרִ֖יק יַעְזֹ֑רוּ לָכֵן֙ קָרָ֣אתִי לָזֹ֔את רַ֥הַב הֵ֖ם שָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miṣ·ra·yim he·ḇel wā·rîq ya‘·zō·rū lā·ḵên qā·rā·ṯî lā·zōṯ ra·haḇ hêm šā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: Egypt’s help is futile and empty therefore I have called her Rahab Who Sits Still
verses.literalPt: Pois, quanto ao Egito, vão e de nenhum valor é o seu auxílio; por isso, lhe tenho chamado Raabe que não se move.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה בּ֣וֹא כָתְבָ֥הּ עַל־ ל֛וּחַ אִתָּ֖ם וְעַל־ סֵ֣פֶר חֻקָּ֑הּ וּתְהִי֙ לְי֣וֹם אַחֲר֔וֹן לָעַ֖ד עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh bō·w ḵā·ṯə·ḇāh ‘al- lū·aḥ ’it·tām wə·‘al- sê·p̄er ḥuq·qāh ū·ṯə·hî lə·yō·wm ’a·ḥă·rō·wn lā·‘aḏ ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Go now write it on a tablet in their presence and inscribe it on a scroll it will be for the days to come a witness forever and ever
verses.literalPt: Vai, escreve isso numa tabuinha perante eles e registra-o num livro, a fim de que fique até os dias vindouros, para sempre e perpetuamente.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם מְרִי֙ ה֔וּא בָּנִ֖ים כֶּחָשִׁ֑ים בָּנִ֕ים לֹֽא־ אָב֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹעַ תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘am mə·rî hū bā·nîm ke·ḥā·šîm bā·nîm lō- ’ā·ḇū šə·mō·w·a‘ tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: These are rebellious people deceitful children children unwilling to obey the LORD’s instruction
verses.literalPt: Pois é um povo rebelde, são filhos mentirosos, filhos que não querem ouvir a instrução de Jeová.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמְר֤וּ לָֽרֹאִים֙ לֹ֣א תִרְא֔וּ וְלַ֣חֹזִ֔ים לֹ֥א תֶחֱזוּ־ לָ֖נוּ נְכֹח֑וֹת דַּבְּרוּ־ לָ֣נוּ חֲלָק֔וֹת חֲז֖וּ מַהֲתַלּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ’ā·mə·rū lā·rō·’îm lō ṯir·’ū wə·la·ḥō·zîm lō ṯe·ḥĕ·zū- lā·nū nə·ḵō·ḥō·wṯ dab·bə·rū- lā·nū ḥă·lā·qō·wṯ ḥă·zū ma·hă·ṯal·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: They say to the seers Stop seeing visions and to the prophets Do not prophesy to us the truth Speak to us pleasant words prophesy illusions
verses.literalPt: Eles dizem aos videntes: Não vejais; e aos profetas: Não nos profetizeis coisas retas, falai-nos coisas aprazíveis, profetizai ilusões;

verses.original: ס֚וּרוּ מִנֵּי־ דֶ֔רֶךְ הַטּ֖וּ מִנֵּי־ אֹ֑רַח הַשְׁבִּ֥יתוּ מִפָּנֵ֖ינוּ אֶת־ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: sū·rū min·nê- ḏe·reḵ haṭ·ṭū min·nê- ’ō·raḥ haš·bî·ṯū mip·pā·nê·nū ’eṯ- qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Get out of the way turn off . . . the road Rid us of the Holy One of Israel
verses.literalPt: apartai-vos do caminho, desviai-vos da vereda, fazei que o Santo de Israel desapareça de diante de nós.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֥עַן מָֽאָסְכֶ֖ם בַּדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַֽתִּבְטְחוּ֙ בְּעֹ֣שֶׁק וְנָל֔וֹז וַתִּֽשָּׁעֲנ֖וּ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl ya·‘an mā·’ā·sə·ḵem bad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh wat·tiḇ·ṭə·ḥū bə·‘ō·šeq wə·nā·lō·wz wat·tiš·šā·‘ă·nū ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says Because you have rejected this message trusting in oppression and relying on deceit
verses.literalPt: Por isso, assim diz o Santo de Israel: Porquanto rejeitais esta palavra, confiais na opressão e perversidade e sobre elas vos estribais,

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יִֽהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ הֶעָוֺ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה כְּפֶ֣רֶץ נֹפֵ֔ל נִבְעֶ֖ה בְּחוֹמָ֣ה נִשְׂגָּבָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ פִּתְאֹ֥ם לְפֶ֖תַע יָב֥וֹא שִׁבְרָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yih·yeh lā·ḵem he·‘ā·wōn haz·zeh kə·p̄e·reṣ nō·p̄êl niḇ·‘eh bə·ḥō·w·māh niś·gā·ḇāh ’ă·šer- piṯ·’ōm lə·p̄e·ṯa‘ yā·ḇō·w šiḇ·rāh
verses.literal: this iniquity of yours is like a breach about to fail a bulge in a high wall whose collapse will come suddenly in an instant
verses.literalPt: portanto esta iniquidade vos será como uma brecha que, prestes a cair, forma barriga num alto muro, cuja queda vem de repente, num momento.

verses.original: וּ֠שְׁבָרָהּ כְּשֵׁ֨בֶר נֵ֧בֶל יוֹצְרִ֛ים כָּת֖וּת לֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל וְלֹֽא־ יִמָּצֵ֤א בִמְכִתָּתוֹ֙ חֶ֔רֶשׂ לַחְתּ֥וֹת אֵשׁ֙ מִיָּק֔וּד וְלַחְשֹׂ֥ף מַ֖יִם מִגֶּֽבֶא׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·ḇā·rāh kə·šê·ḇer nê·ḇel yō·wṣ·rîm kā·ṯūṯ lō yaḥ·mōl wə·lō- yim·mā·ṣê ḇim·ḵit·tā·ṯōw ḥe·reś laḥ·tō·wṯ ’êš mî·yā·qūḏ wə·laḥ·śōp̄ ma·yim mig·ge·ḇe
verses.literal: It will break in pieces like a potter’s jar shattered so that no fragment . . . can be found Not a shard will be found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth or to skim the water from a cistern
verses.literalPt: Jeová o quebrará como se quebra um vaso de oleiro, despedaçando-o por completo; de sorte que não se achará entre os seus pedacinhos um caco em que se leve fogo da lareira ou com que se tire água da cisterna.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹֽה־ אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּשׁוּבָ֤ה וָנַ֙חַת֙ תִּוָּ֣שֵׁע֔וּן בְּהַשְׁקֵט֙ וּבְבִטְחָ֔ה תִּהְיֶ֖ה גְּבֽוּרַתְכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֖א אֲבִיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl bə·šū·ḇāh wā·na·ḥaṯ tiw·wā·šê·‘ūn bə·haš·qêṭ ū·ḇə·ḇiṭ·ḥāh tih·yeh gə·ḇū·raṯ·ḵem wə·lō ’ă·ḇî·ṯem
verses.literal: For . . . the Lord GOD the Holy One of Israel has said By repentance and rest you would be saved your strength would lie in quiet confidence but you were not willing
verses.literalPt: Pois assim disse o Senhor Jeová, o Santo de Israel: Voltando e descansando, sereis salvos; no sossego e na confiança, estará a vossa força. Vós não quisestes;

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמְר֥וּ לֹא־ כִ֛י עַל־ ס֥וּס נָנ֖וּס עַל־ כֵּ֣ן תְּנוּס֑וּן וְעַל־ קַ֣ל נִרְכָּ֔ב עַל־ כֵּ֖ן יִקַּ֥לּוּ רֹדְפֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mə·rū lō- ḵî ‘al- sūs nā·nūs ‘al- kên tə·nū·sūn wə·‘al- qal nir·kāḇ ‘al- kên yiq·qal·lū rō·ḏə·p̄ê·ḵem
verses.literal: No you say . . . we will flee on horses Therefore . . . you will flee We will ride . . . . . . . . . swift horses but your pursuers will be faster
verses.literalPt: antes dissestes: Não, mas sobre cavalos fugiremos (portanto, haveis de fugir) e sobre cavalos ligeiros cavalgaremos (portanto, hão de ser ligeiros os que te perseguirem).

verses.original: אֶ֣לֶף אֶחָ֗ד מִפְּנֵי֙ גַּעֲרַ֣ת אֶחָ֔ד מִפְּנֵ֛י גַּעֲרַ֥ת חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה תָּנֻ֑סוּ עַ֣ד אִם־ נוֹתַרְתֶּ֗ם כַּתֹּ֙רֶן֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֔ר וְכַנֵּ֖ס עַל־ הַגִּבְעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·lep̄ ’e·ḥāḏ mip·pə·nê ga·‘ă·raṯ ’e·ḥāḏ mip·pə·nê ga·‘ă·raṯ ḥă·miš·šāh tā·nu·sū ‘aḏ ’im- nō·w·ṯar·tem kat·tō·ren ‘al- rōš hā·hār wə·ḵan·nês ‘al- hag·giḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: A thousand will flee at the threat of one at the threat of five you will all flee until . . . you are left alone like a pole on a mountaintop . . . like a banner on a hill
verses.literalPt: Pela ameaça de um só, fugirão mil; e, pela ameaça de cinco, fugireis, até que fiqueis como um mastro no cume de um monte e como um estandarte sobre um outeiro.

verses.original: וְלָכֵ֞ן יְחַכֶּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לַֽחֲנַנְכֶ֔ם וְלָכֵ֥ן יָר֖וּם לְרַֽחֶמְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ יְהוָ֔ה אַשְׁרֵ֖י כָּל־ ח֥וֹכֵי לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·ḵên yə·ḥak·keh Yah·weh la·ḥă·nan·ḵem wə·lā·ḵên yā·rūm lə·ra·ḥem·ḵem kî- ’ĕ·lō·hê miš·pāṭ Yah·weh ’aš·rê kāl- ḥō·w·ḵê lōw
verses.literal: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you therefore He rises to show you compassion for the LORD is a just God Blessed are all who wait for Him
verses.literalPt: Por esse motivo, esperará Jeová para se apiedar de vós e se levantará para ter compaixão de vós, porque Jeová é Deus de juízos; bem-aventurados todos os que por ele esperam.

verses.original: כִּי־ עַ֛ם בְּצִיּ֥וֹן יֵשֵׁ֖ב בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בָּכ֣וֹ לֹֽא־ תִבְכֶּ֗ה חָנ֤וֹן יָחְנְךָ֙ לְק֣וֹל זַעֲקֶ֔ךָ כְּשָׁמְעָת֖וֹ עָנָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘am bə·ṣî·yō·wn yê·šêḇ bî·rū·šā·lim bā·ḵōw lō- ṯiḇ·keh ḥā·nō·wn yā·ḥə·nə·ḵā lə·qō·wl za·‘ă·qe·ḵā kə·šā·mə·‘ā·ṯōw ‘ā·nāḵ
verses.literal: O people in Zion who dwell in Jerusalem you will weep no more He will surely be gracious . . . when you cry for help . . . when He hears He will answer you
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, o povo habitará em Sião, em Jerusalém. Tu não chorarás mais; certamente, se compadecerá de ti à voz do seu clamor; quando te ouvir, te responderá.

verses.original: וְנָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֧ם אֲדֹנָ֛י לֶ֥חֶם צָ֖ר וּמַ֣יִם לָ֑חַץ וְלֹֽא־ יִכָּנֵ֥ף עוֹד֙ מוֹרֶ֔יךָ וְהָי֥וּ עֵינֶ֖יךָ רֹא֥וֹת אֶת־ מוֹרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan lā·ḵem ’ă·ḏō·nāy le·ḥem ṣār ū·ma·yim lā·ḥaṣ wə·lō- yik·kā·nêp̄ ‘ō·wḏ mō·w·re·ḵā wə·hā·yū ‘ê·ne·ḵā rō·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- mō·w·re·ḵā
verses.literal: The Lord will give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction but your Teacher will no longer hide Himself . . . with your own eyes you will see Him
verses.literalPt: Embora Jeová vos dê pão de adversidade e água de aflição, contudo, não se esconderão mais os teus mestres; os teus olhos verão os teus mestres.

verses.original: וְאָזְנֶ֙יךָ֙ תִּשְׁמַ֣עְנָה דָבָ֔ר מֵֽאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֤ה הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ לְכ֣וּ ב֔וֹ כִּ֥י תַאֲמִ֖ינוּ וְכִ֥י תַשְׂמְאִֽילוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·zə·ne·ḵā tiš·ma‘·nāh ḏā·ḇār mê·’a·ḥă·re·ḵā lê·mōr zeh had·de·reḵ lə·ḵū ḇōw kî ṯa·’ă·mî·nū wə·ḵî ṯaś·mə·’î·lū
verses.literal: And whether you turn to the right . . . or to the left your ears will hear this command behind you . . . This is the way Walk in it
verses.literalPt: Quando vos desviardes para a direita e quando vos desviardes para a esquerda, os teus ouvidos ouvirão atrás de ti uma palavra, dizendo: Este é o caminho, andai por ele.

verses.original: וְטִמֵּאתֶ֗ם אֶת־ צִפּוּי֙ פְּסִילֵ֣י כַסְפֶּ֔ךָ וְאֶת־ אֲפֻדַּ֖ת מַסֵּכַ֣ת זְהָבֶ֑ךָ תִּזְרֵם֙ כְּמ֣וֹ דָוָ֔ה צֵ֖א תֹּ֥אמַר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭim·mê·ṯem ’eṯ- ṣip·pui pə·sî·lê ḵas·pe·ḵā wə·’eṯ- ’ă·p̄ud·daṯ mas·sê·ḵaṯ zə·hā·ḇe·ḵā tiz·rêm kə·mōw ḏā·wāh ṣê tō·mar lōw
verses.literal: So you will desecrate your silver-plated . . . idols and your gold-plated . . . images You will throw them away like menstrual cloths saying to them Be gone
verses.literalPt: Contaminareis a cobertura das tuas imagens esculpidas, de prata, e a vestidura das tuas imagens fundidas, de ouro; lançá-las-ás fora como coisa imunda e dir-lhe-ás: Vai-te daqui!

verses.original: וְנָתַן֩ מְטַ֨ר זַרְעֲךָ֜ אֲשֶׁר־ תִּזְרַ֣ע אֶת־ הָאֲדָמָ֗ה וְלֶ֙חֶם֙ תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה דָשֵׁ֖ן וְשָׁמֵ֑ן יִרְעֶ֥ה מִקְנֶ֛יךָ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כַּ֥ר נִרְחָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan mə·ṭar zar·‘ă·ḵā ’ă·šer- tiz·ra‘ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh wə·le·ḥem tə·ḇū·’aṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh wə·hā·yāh ḏā·šên wə·šā·mên yir·‘eh miq·ne·ḵā bay·yō·wm ha·hū kar nir·ḥāḇ
verses.literal: Then He will send rain for the seed that you have sown in the ground and the food that comes from your land will be rich and plentiful On that day your cattle will graze in open pastures
verses.literalPt: Jeová dará chuva para a tua semente, com a qual semearás a terra, e pão da novidade da terra, o qual será pingue e abundante. Naquele dia, será apascentado o teu gado em largos pastos.

verses.original: וְהָאֲלָפִ֣ים וְהָעֲיָרִ֗ים עֹֽבְדֵי֙ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה בְּלִ֥יל חָמִ֖יץ יֹאכֵ֑לוּ אֲשֶׁר־ זֹרֶ֥ה בָרַ֖חַת וּבַמִּזְרֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·hā·‘ă·yā·rîm ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh bə·lîl ḥā·mîṣ yō·ḵê·lū ’ă·šer- zō·reh ḇā·ra·ḥaṯ ū·ḇam·miz·reh
verses.literal: The oxen and donkeys that work the ground will eat salted fodder winnowed with shovel and pitchfork
verses.literalPt: Também os bois e os jumentinhos que lavram a terra comerão feno com sal, feno que terá sido alimpado com a pá e com a joeira.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ עַל־ כָּל־ הַ֣ר גָּבֹ֗הַ וְעַל֙ כָּל־ גִּבְעָ֣ה נִשָּׂאָ֔ה פְּלָגִ֖ים יִבְלֵי־ מָ֑יִם בְּיוֹם֙ הֶ֣רֶג רָ֔ב בִּנְפֹ֖ל מִגְדָּלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ‘al- kāl- har gå̄·ḇō·ha wə·‘al kāl- giḇ·‘āh niś·śā·’āh pə·lā·ḡîm yiḇ·lê- mā·yim bə·yō·wm he·reḡ rāḇ bin·p̄ōl miḡ·dā·lîm
verses.literal: And from every high . . . mountain and every raised hill streams of water will flow in the day of great slaughter when the towers fall
verses.literalPt: Sobre todo o monte elevado e sobre todo o outeiro alto haverá ribeiros e torrentes de águas, no dia da grande matança, quando caírem as torres.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה אֽוֹר־ הַלְּבָנָה֙ כְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַמָּ֔ה וְא֤וֹר הַֽחַמָּה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שִׁבְעָתַ֔יִם כְּא֖וֹר שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים בְּי֗וֹם חֲבֹ֤שׁ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ שֶׁ֣בֶר עַמּ֔וֹ וּמַ֥חַץ מַכָּת֖וֹ יִרְפָּֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ō·wr- hal·lə·ḇā·nāh kə·’ō·wr ha·ḥam·māh wə·’ō·wr ha·ḥam·māh yih·yeh šiḇ·‘ā·ṯa·yim kə·’ō·wr šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm bə·yō·wm ḥă·ḇōš Yah·weh ’eṯ- še·ḇer ‘am·mōw ū·ma·ḥaṣ mak·kā·ṯōw yir·pā
verses.literal: The light of the moon . . . will be as bright as the sun . . . and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter like the light of seven days on the day that the LORD binds up the brokenness of His people and heals the wounds He has inflicted
verses.literalPt: Demais, a luz da lua será como a luz do sol, e a luz do sol será sétupla como a luz de sete dias, no dia em que Jeová atar a ferida do seu povo e curar o golpe da sua chaga.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה שֵׁם־ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֣א מִמֶּרְחָ֔ק בֹּעֵ֣ר אַפּ֔וֹ וְכֹ֖בֶד מַשָּׂאָ֑ה שְׂפָתָיו֙ מָ֣לְאוּ זַ֔עַם וּלְשׁוֹנ֖וֹ כְּאֵ֥שׁ אֹכָֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh šêm- Yah·weh bā mim·mer·ḥāq bō·‘êr ’ap·pōw wə·ḵō·ḇeḏ maś·śā·’āh śə·p̄ā·ṯāw mā·lə·’ū za·‘am ū·lə·šō·w·nōw kə·’êš ’ō·ḵā·leṯ
verses.literal: Behold the Name of the LORD comes from afar with burning anger and dense smoke His lips are full of fury and His tongue is like a consuming fire
verses.literalPt: Eis que o nome de Jeová vem de longe, ardendo na sua ira e numa densa massa de fumo; os seus lábios estão cheios de indignação, e a sua língua é como um fogo devorante.

verses.original: וְרוּח֞וֹ כְּנַ֤חַל שׁוֹטֵף֙ עַד־ צַוָּ֣אר יֶֽחֱצֶ֔ה לַהֲנָפָ֥ה גוֹיִ֖ם בְּנָ֣פַת שָׁ֑וְא וְרֶ֣סֶן מַתְעֶ֔ה עַ֖ל לְחָיֵ֥י עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rū·ḥōw kə·na·ḥal šō·w·ṭêp̄ ‘aḏ- ṣaw·wār ye·ḥĕ·ṣeh la·hă·nā·p̄āh ḡō·w·yim bə·nā·p̄aṯ šāw wə·re·sen maṯ·‘eh ‘al lə·ḥā·yê ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: His breath is like a rushing torrent that rises to the neck He comes to sift the nations in a sieve of destruction He bridles the jaws of the peoples to lead them astray
verses.literalPt: O seu assopro é como uma torrente que inunda e chega até o pescoço para cirandar as nações com a ciranda de vaidade; um freio que induz ao erro estará nos queixos dos povos.

verses.original: הַשִּׁיר֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כְּלֵ֖יל הִתְקַדֶּשׁ־ חָ֑ג וְשִׂמְחַ֣ת לֵבָ֗ב כַּֽהוֹלֵךְ֙ בֶּֽחָלִ֔יל לָב֥וֹא בְהַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ צ֥וּר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šîr yih·yeh lā·ḵem kə·lêl hiṯ·qad·deš- ḥāḡ wə·śim·ḥaṯ lê·ḇāḇ ka·hō·w·lêḵ be·ḥā·lîl lā·ḇō·w ḇə·har- Yah·weh ’el- ṣūr yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You will sing . . . as on the night of a holy festival and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute going up to the mountain of the LORD to the Rock of Israel
verses.literalPt: O vosso cântico será como o da noite em que se guarda uma santa festividade; e a alegria do vosso coração, como a de quem se põe a caminho ao som da flauta para ir ao monte de Jeová, à Rocha de Israel.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁמִ֨יעַ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ ה֣וֹד קוֹל֗וֹ וְנַ֤חַת זְרוֹעוֹ֙ יַרְאֶ֔ה בְּזַ֣עַף אַ֔ף וְלַ֖הַב אֵ֣שׁ אוֹכֵלָ֑ה נֶ֥פֶץ וָזֶ֖רֶם וְאֶ֥בֶן בָּרָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·mî·a‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- hō·wḏ qō·w·lōw wə·na·ḥaṯ zə·rō·w·‘ōw yar·’eh bə·za·‘ap̄ ’ap̄ wə·la·haḇ ’êš ’ō·w·ḵê·lāh ne·p̄eṣ wā·ze·rem wə·’e·ḇen bā·rāḏ
verses.literal: And the LORD will cause His majestic voice to be heard and His mighty arm to be revealed striking in angry wrath with a flame of consuming fire and with cloudburst storm and hailstones . . .
verses.literalPt: Jeová fará ouvir a sua voz gloriosa e mostrará a descida do seu braço na indignação da sua ira, na chama de um fogo devorante, no arrebentar de nuvens, na tempestade de chuva e na saraiva.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מִקּ֥וֹל יְהוָ֖ה יֵחַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר בַּשֵּׁ֖בֶט יַכֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- miq·qō·wl Yah·weh yê·ḥaṯ ’aš·šūr baš·šê·ḇeṭ yak·keh
verses.literal: For Assyria will be shattered at the voice of the LORD He will strike them with His scepter
verses.literalPt: Pois, pela voz de Jeová, será despedaçado o assírio, a quem ele feriu com a vara.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כֹּ֤ל מַֽעֲבַר֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מֽוּסָדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנִ֤יחַ יְהוָה֙ עָלָ֔יו בְּתֻפִּ֖ים וּבְכִנֹּר֑וֹת וּבְמִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תְּנוּפָ֖ה נִלְחַם־ בָּהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kōl ma·‘ă·ḇar maṭ·ṭêh mū·sā·ḏāh ’ă·šer yā·nî·aḥ Yah·weh ‘ā·lāw bə·ṯup·pîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·mil·ḥă·mō·wṯ tə·nū·p̄āh nil·ḥam- bå̄h
verses.literal: And with every stroke of the rod of punishment that the LORD brings down on them the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished
verses.literalPt: Cada varada que Jeová lhe aplicar com a vara para isso destinada será com tambores e harpas; e pelejará contra eles em batalhas em que agitará essa vara.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָר֤וּךְ מֵֽאֶתְמוּל֙ תָּפְתֶּ֔ה גַּם־ הוּא לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הוּכָ֖ן הֶעְמִ֣יק הִרְחִ֑ב מְדֻרָתָ֗הּ אֵ֤שׁ וְעֵצִים֙ הַרְבֵּ֔ה נִשְׁמַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ כְּנַ֣חַל גָּפְרִ֔ית בֹּעֲרָ֖ה בָּֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·rūḵ mê·’eṯ·mūl tā·p̄ə·teh gam- hū lam·me·leḵ hū·ḵān he‘·mîq hir·ḥiḇ mə·ḏu·rā·ṯāh ’êš wə·‘ê·ṣîm har·bêh niš·maṯ Yah·weh kə·na·ḥal gā·p̄ə·rîṯ bō·‘ă·rāh bāh
verses.literal: For Topheth has long been prepared it has been made ready for the king Its funeral pyre is deep and wide with plenty of fire and wood The breath of the LORD like a torrent of burning sulfur sets it ablaze
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, Tofete está, de há muito, preparado; sim, para o rei está aparelhado. Foi feito profundo e dilatado; a sua pira tem fogo e muita lenha; o assopro de Jeová, como uma torrente de enxofre, é o que o acende.
